CustomField.description: The Organization (Account, record type Organization) this roster belongs to. Relationships intake only creates or terminates relationships at facilities whose Healthcare Facility Legal Owner is this Organization or an Organization below it (OrganizationScope); errors name it when a facility is outside that scope. Provider intake does not use it: Providers are global. Deleting the Organization deletes its rosters, with their runs and issues.
CustomField.label: Organization
